## Insider Selling at Analog Devices Flagged by Multiple Outlets Ahead of Aug. 19 Earnings

Insider selling flagged across multiple outlets immediately ahead of an earnings date warrants attention, but 10b5-1 plan sales are common and expected; confirm plan versus discretionary status before drawing a negative inference — discretionary selling pre-earnings would be a materially different signal than scheduled plan execution.

- Insider selling at ADI is highlighted across two outlets (Moomoo, simplywall.st), amplifying the visibility of the signal.
- The 'don't ignore' framing implies the selling is notable in scale or context, though no transaction size, insider identity, share count, or price is specified in the headlines.
- Critical distinction — whether sales are under a pre-scheduled 10b5-1 plan (routine) or discretionary (potentially informative) — is not resolvable from the headlines.
- Timing is notable given ADI earnings are due August 19.
